electrical_channel_constraints.cable_type: Cat 5 / Cat 5e UTP, 100 Ω characteristic impedance
electrical_channel_constraints.connector: 8P8C / RJ-45, or industrial M8 / M12 / M23

environmental_constraints.spec: IEC 61000-4-2 ± 4 kV contact discharge on Ethernet ports

fields.pdk_pdf_note: The ETG Brochure is a system + protocol-level document. Silicon-level constraints (process node, P&R rules, library Vt/Vdd selection) are NOT in scope — those are defined by the ESC ASIC vendor or the FPGA fabric chosen for IP integration.
fields.notes: EtherCAT MainDevice has no special silicon constraints (any standard NIC). EtherCAT G adds the IEEE 802.3 1000BASE-T / 1000BASE-X electrical envelope to the constraint list.
